name_note: Genomes GTDB places in Duodenibacillus are deposited in NCBI partly under Sutterella names, and published findings use the species name Duodenibacillus massiliensis.

sentences.text: Duodenibacillus massiliensis was described from a human duodenum liquid sample taken from a 60-year-old man.

A study of children with Pediatric Inflammatory Multisystem Syndrome, a post-infectious inflammatory condition associated with SARS-CoV-2, reported increased relative abundance of Duodenibacillus massiliensis.
Another study reported examination stress to be associated with lower relative abundance of Duodenibacillus massiliensis.
A review describes evidence linking microbial signatures including Duodenibacillus massiliensis to chemoradiotherapy efficacy and resistance in rectal cancer.
